# Files

## File: public/docs/# INFINITELY STUDIO — COMPLETE PLUGIN AR.md
````markdown
# INFINITELY STUDIO — COMPLETE PLUGIN ARCHITECTURE (v2, exhaustive)
> Hand-off doc for AI agents. WordPress half of a headless builder.
> Editor = React + GrapesJS + Recoil + React Query on localhost:5173 / infinitely.pages.dev.
> All editor↔WP traffic goes through REST under `infinitely-api/v1`.
> Sections tagged [verify] describe files not present in the reference upload —
> behavior reconstructed from session history; confirm against source before editing.

---

## 1. PHILOSOPHY / MENTAL MODEL
- Pages are **JSON component trees** stored in post meta `inf_meta`, never raw HTML.
- WP **renders trees server-side** on every request (`render.php`).
- Dynamic values = **tokens** `{{dot.path}}` resolved against a **context** array.
- Loops/queries/conditions/pagination/SSR = **custom attributes** on nodes
  (`inf-for`, `inf-query-id`, `inf-if-json`, `inf-pagination-id`, `inf-ssr`…).
- Extensibility = WP filters (`inf/context`, `inf/normalize_post`, `inf_render_component`,
  `inf/tokens/schema`, `inf_before_render_components`) + **add-ons** (WooCommerce, ACF)
  + **snippets** (user PHP fired on any hook).
- Auth model: **no nonces**. `inf_query_permission` = logged-in + Origin ∈ ALLOWED_ORIGINS.
  Editor sends `Authorization: Basic base64(user:app_password)` + `credentials:'include'`.

---

## 2. COMPLETE FILE TREE
```
infinitely/
├── infinitely.php               # bootstrap, load order, activation, inf_option_permission
├── constants.php                # HIDDEN_POSTS, MAIN_ENDPOINT_NAME, ALLOWED_ORIGINS, ADD_ONES(+CHECKERS)
├── helpers.php                  # normalize_post + filters, checkers, render-state, template helpers
├── tokens.php                   # token engine: resolver, renderer, context, schema, /render-tokens
├── permissions.php              # CORS, mime whitelist, filetype fix, htaccess CORS, inf_query_permission
├── enqueue_project_scripts.php  # all front-end assets, cache-busting, wpApiSettings
├── reload.php                   # [verify] HMR/reload helpers for preview
├── CPTs.php                     # inf_symbols, inf_blocks, inf_motions (+ inf_snippets added later)
├── custom_meta.php              # inf_meta (any-keys object), inf_template_type, inf_disalbe
├── inf_template.php             # [verify] template capture + WP hierarchy → inf_template post
├── conditions.php               # [verify] inf_get_condition_value (operators), inf_eval_expression
├── render.php                   # template_include pipeline, component renderer, body handling
├── rest/
│   ├── rest.php                 # [verify] editor CRUD routes + /get-tokens + /asset + resolvers
│   ├── query.php                # POST /query (WP_Query JSON)
│   └── snippets.php             # snippets CRUD + execute + dynamic hook registration
├── components/
│   └── index.php                # [verify] inf-query / inf-pagination / inf-for / inf-ssr overrides
├── add-ones/
│   ├── woocommerce/
│   │   ├── woocommerce.php      # product enrichment via inf/normalize_post
│   │   └── cart.php             # cart REST endpoints + inf_get_cart_data
│   └── ACF/
│       └── acf.php              # ACF fields → {{post.acf.*}} via inf/normalize_post
└── templates/
    └── inf-full-document-inline.php  # shell that echoes $GLOBALS['inf_full_html']
```

---

## 3. BOOT ORDER (infinitely.php)
1. `constants.php` → 2. `helpers.php` → 3. `tokens.php` → 4. `enqueue_project_scripts.php`
→ 5. `reload.php` → 6. `CPTs.php` → 7. `rest/rest.php` → 8. `inf_template.php`
→ 9. `custom_meta.php` → defines `MY_PLUGIN_DIR/URL` → `init`: load add-ons whose
checker returns true → `render.php`.
Activation: forces permalink `/%postname%/` + `flush_rewrite_rules()`.
`inf_option_permission()` = `manage_options` AND `inf_query_permission(null)`.

Add-on loader pattern:
```php
ADD_ONES        = ['woocommerce'=>'/add-ones/woocommerce/woocommerce.php',
                   'acf'=>'/add-ones/ACF/acf.php'];
ADD_ONES_CHECKERS = ['woocommerce'=>'inf_is_woocommerce_active',
                     'acf'=>'inf_is_acf_active'];   // strings — evaluated on init, not at define time
```

---

## 4. constants.php (exact)
```php
define('HIDDEN_POSTS', ["inf_template" => "inf_template"]); // add "inf_snippets" recommended
define('MAIN_ENDPOINT_NAME', 'infinitely-api/v1');
define('ALLOWED_ORIGINS', ['https://infinitely.pages.dev','https://localhost:5173',
  'http://localhost:5173','https://127.0.0.1:5173','http://127.0.0.1:5173']);
```

---

## 5. permissions.php (exact behavior)
- **CORS**: `rest_pre_serve_request` filter → ACAO/credentials/methods/headers for allowed
  origin; OPTIONS exits early.
- **upload_mimes**: merges big whitelist (images/video/audio/js/css/json/fonts/docs).
- **wp_check_filetype_and_ext** (TWO filters in shipped file — known bug source):
  old code `$mimes[$ext] ?? '*/*'` wrote `*/*` into `post_mime_type`.
  FIXED pattern = single filter using one whitelist function `inf_allowed_mimes()`,
  never `*/*`, unknown ext → return `$data` untouched.
- **rest_prepare_attachment**: finfo real mime → `mime_type`, `media_type`, `svg_content`.
- **inf_generate_htaccess_cors()** on `init`: appends SetEnvIf CORS block for
  fonts/svg/splinecode to ABSPATH `.htaccess` (idempotent marker comment).
- **inf_query_permission($req)**: `is_user_logged_in()` && origin ∈ ALLOWED_ORIGINS (strict).

---

## 6. helpers.php
- `normalize_post($post_id)` → `[...(array)$post, id, type, meta(all, unserialized),
  tax(all taxonomies→terms), media{thumbnail_id,thumbnail_url,attachments},
  author(userdata), content, post_content, helmet]` then
  `apply_filters('inf/normalize_post', $result, $post->ID, $post)` ← THE enrichment point.
- `inf_is_woocommerce_active()`: class `WooCommerce` ∥ `is_plugin_active('woocommerce/woocommerce.php')`
  (multisite: `is_plugin_active_for_network`).
- `inf_is_acf_active()`: `class_exists('acf') ∥ defined('ACF_VERSION')` ∥ plugin-active
  (`advanced-custom-fields/acf.php` ∥ `advanced-custom-fields-pro/acf.php`).
- Render state: `inf_set_render_state()/inf_get_render_state()` (default `'saved'`).
- Template: `inf_capture_current_template($wp_template)`, `inf_get_current_template()`.
- Callbacks: `if_template_only(cb)`, `if_post_only(cb)`, `if_template_with_post(cb)`.
- Mode: `is_preview_mode()`, `inf_get_dev_mode()`, `inf_get_dev_mode_state()`.
- Misc: `get_infinitely_url()/get_infinitely_dir()`, `define_font_face($slug,$url)`,
  `inf_motions_registry($script=null)` (accumulator for one-shot motions),
  `replace_normal_with_symbol($state,$meta)`, `inf_render_page_data($t_meta,$p_meta)`.

---

## 7. tokens.php (exact)
- `inf_get_by_path($data,$path)` — dot-path over arrays/objects, null on miss.
- `get_token()`, `extract_context_tokens()` — regex `/\{\{\s*([\w.]+)\s*\}\}/`.
- `inf_render_tokens($template,$context,$for_eval=false)`:
  html_entity_decode → token replace (array/object → json if eval else ''; string → quoted
  if eval else raw; scalar cast) → if `<?php` present: `eval('?>'.$tpl)` in ob + try/catch.
- `inf_build_context($post_id,$post_type)` groups: `post`(normalize_post), `user`, `site`,
  `theme`, `request`, `query`(conditional tags), `time`, `env`, `db`;
  then `apply_filters('inf/context',$context,$filter_meta{post_id,post_type,post})`;
  stores `global $inf_context`. (Post-type alias line is commented out — aliases like
  `prod`, `sliderProd` come from `/get-tokens` vars, not magic.)
- Schema: `INF_TOKENS_EXCLUDED_GROUPS=['request','env','db']`;
  leaf pattern `/(pass|secret|activation_key|nonce|^caps$|allcaps|cap_key)/i`;
  `inf_get_tokens_schema($ctx,$opts{max_depth:5,max_leaves:400})` walks LIVE context via
  `inf_context_to_json()` (objects→to_array/public vars); list arrays sample index 0;
  leaves `{key,label,type,live_value,resolves}`; final `inf/tokens/schema` filter.
- REST `POST /render-tokens` (auth `inf_query_permission` — it evals PHP): `{template,post_id,post_type}`.
- ⚠️ `max_leaves=0` ⇒ empty groups (precedence bug class `(int)$x ?? default`).

---

## 8. CPTs.php (exact + addition)
Shared headless args: public, no UI, `show_in_rest`, `WP_REST_Posts_Controller`.
Registered: `inf_symbols` (title,editor,thumbnail), `inf_blocks` (same), `inf_motions`.
Added later: `inf_snippets` (title, custom-fields) — store for snippets system (§15).

---

## 9. custom_meta.php (exact)
- `inf_meta`: type object, single, REST schema `additionalProperties:true`, auth `edit_posts`,
  registered on `''` (all types).
- `inf_template_type` (string) on every non-HIDDEN type.
- `inf_disalbe` (boolean) on `inf_template`.

---

## 10. inf_template.php [verify]
- `inf_capture_current_template($tpl)` remembers WP-chosen template file.
- `inf_get_current_template()` maps WP hierarchy → `inf_template` post via `inf_template_type`:
  index, singular, single, page, archive, home, front-page, category, tag, taxonomy,
  author, date, search, 404, plus `single-{cpt}` / `archive-{cpt}`.

---

## 11. conditions.php [verify]
- `inf_get_condition_value($rendered_var,$operator,$value)` operators:
  equals, not_equals, includes, contains, gt, gte, lt, lte, exists, empty (subset confirmed:
  equals/includes/contains/gt).
- `inf_eval_expression()` — legacy `inf-if` string evaluator (disabled in render.php).

---

## 12. components/index.php [verify]
Hooks `inf_render_component` filter; string return overrides node output.
- **inf-query**: attrs `inf-query-id`, `inf-query` (inline JSON WP_Query args) or saved
  `inf_config.queries[id]`, `inf-query-item` (loop var name; default from post_type).
  Runs WP_Query, per-post sets loop var = `normalize_post(id)`, renders children.
- **inf-pagination**: attr `inf-pagination-id` → context `pagination` =
  `{pagination_links[]{type:current|number|prev|next,url,text}, prev_link, next_link,
   current, max_number, allow_numbers, allow_prev_next, query_id}`;
  attrs `allow-numbers, allow-prev-next, max-show, max-style(window-first-last)`.
- **inf-for**: `inf-for="{{list}}"`, `inf-for-item`, `inf-for-index` — clone per item,
  item/index become context keys (nested loops supported).
- **inf-ssr**: `url, method, headers, response-ver` + `ssr-loop/ssr-for-item/ssr-for-index`
  — server-side remote fetch loop.

---

## 13. render.php (exact)
- `template_include` prio **5500**: `inf_set_render_state('saved')` → capture template →
  build context → resolve `$template_post`.
  - Non-singular: render template html only.
  - Singular: render post html → inject as `$context['post']['post_content']` → render template.
  - Output via `inf-full-document-inline.php` + `$GLOBALS['inf_full_html']`.
- `rest_api_init`: REST field `inf_meta` on ALL post types; get_callback runs
  `replace_normal_with_symbol()` per state.
- `body_class` filter: merges template + post `bodyAttributes.class`.
- `template_redirect` prio 1: ob_start rewrites `<body …>` appending remaining bodyAttributes
  (class excluded; `get_body_attributes()`).
- `inf_render_components(array,$save_state)`: fires
  `apply_filters('inf_before_render_components', null, $components)` then per node:
- `inf_render_component()`:
  1. `apply_filters('inf_render_component', false, $component, $save_state, $inf_config, $all)`
     — string ⇒ override.
  2. textnode ⇒ raw content.
  3. Motions: `motion-id`/`main-motion-id`+`motion-instance-id` from `inf_config.motions`;
     loop ⇒ `v-gsap` attr; one-shot ⇒ `inf_motions_registry()` (inlined before p-vue).
  4. Interactions: `interaction-id`/`main-interaction-id`+instance ⇒ merge `attr_for_wp`.
  5. `inf-if-json`: array of `{var,operator,value}` joined by "and"/"or" strings;
     var resolved via `inf_render_tokens('{{var}}',$inf_context)`; false ⇒ node renders `''`.
  6. Attributes escaped single-quoted (`esc_attr(html_entity_decode(...))`);
     `classes` array appended as class attr; children recursed.
- `get_components_by_attribute($components,$attr,$val=null)` recursive finder.

---

## 14. enqueue_project_scripts.php
- `$ver = time()` when preview OR state `before_save`, else `'1.2'` (cache-busting law).
- `wp_head` prio 999: `inf_render_page_data()` (template+post / post-only dev).
- `script_loader_tag` filter injects `global $inf_script_attributes[handle]` attrs.
- Enqueue order: jsFooterLibs → header scripts → `inf-builder` (+`inf-hmr` in preview)
  → footer scripts as **dependency chain** (`$prev_handle`) → styles/fonts/globalCss/cssLibs
  → jsHeaderLibs.
- `p-vue-js` special: enqueues `globalJs` before it; injects motions + template JS + post JS
  via `wp_add_inline_script($handle,…,'before')`.
- `wp_localize_script('inf-builder','wpApiSettings',…)`:
  always: `nonce, restUrl, queryUrl, queryMethod, apiBase, tokensUrl, renderTokensUrl,
  assetUrl, ajaxUrl, homeUrl, isLoggedIn`;
  WC-only: `cartUrl, cartAddUrl, cartEnabled, currency`.
- **Script-order law**: `type="module"` always executes AFTER all classic scripts.
  Global-exposing libs (PetiteVue, GSAP, auto-animate) must stay classic/IIFE.
  auto-animate ships as pure global IIFE (`window.autoAnimate/getTransitionSizes/vAutoAnimate`).

---

## 15. REST API — COMPLETE TABLE (base `/wp-json/infinitely-api/v1`)
| Method | Route | Auth | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/get-tokens` | inf_query_permission | params: post_id, post_type, vars(JSON), include_arrays, max_leaves |
| POST | `/render-tokens` | inf_query_permission | evals PHP — never public |
| POST | `/query` | inf_query_permission | body `{query_args}` → normalized posts + found_posts/max_num_pages/current_page |
| GET | `/asset?slug=` | inf_query_permission | base64 JSON `{success,mime,filename,data}` (never raw binary) |
| GET/POST | `/snippets` | inf_query_permission | list / create |
| GET/PUT/DELETE | `/snippets/{id}` | inf_query_permission | |
| POST | `/snippets/{id}/execute`, `/snippets/execute` | inf_query_permission | manual run (`execute` takes `name`) |
| GET | `/cart` | inf_query_permission | WC only |
| POST | `/cart/add` | inf_query_permission | `{product_id,quantity,variation_id,variation}` |
| PUT/DELETE | `/cart/{key}` | inf_query_permission | qty / remove |
| — | editor CRUD [verify] | inf_query_permission | routes backing frontend fns: wp_get, wp_get_posts, wp_get_single, wp_get_header_footer, wp_update_option, wp_update_single, wp_inf_render_components, wp_inf_render_template, media upload/list |
| core | `/{type}` REST field `inf_meta` | WP core | all post types |

### /get-tokens vars — TWO-PASS resolution
Pass 1: `query`, `query_id`, `pagination_query_id`, `ssr_url`, `data`.
Pass 2: `source` (depends on pass-1 context via `inf_resolve_for_var`, list-unwrap to item shape).
Resolvers: `inf_resolve_query_var` (WP_Query→normalize_post first hit),
`inf_resolve_pagination_var`, `inf_resolve_ssr_var` (wp_remote_request + `ssr_response_path`),
`inf_resolve_for_var` (`{{path}}`, brackets→`.0`).

---

## 16. ADD-ONS
### WooCommerce (`add-ones/woocommerce/woocommerce.php`)
`inf/normalize_post` (products): `gallery_urls` (featured first + gallery URLs),
`price, regular_price, sale_price, sku, stock_status, permalink`.
Loads `cart.php`. `inf_get_cart_data()` →
`{items[]{key,product_id,variation_id,name,quantity,price,line_total,thumbnail,permalink,variation},
 item_count,total,subtotal,discount_total,tax_total,shipping_total}`.
### ACF (`add-ones/ACF/acf.php`) — Free & Pro
`inf/normalize_post`: `get_fields($post_id)` → recursive `inf_normalize_acf_values()`:
image-array(url+ID)→URL string; arrays recursed; WP_Post→normalize_post; WP_Term→flat array.
Result under `$result['acf']` → tokens `{{post.acf.*}}`, repeaters loopable.

---

## 17. SNIPPETS SYSTEM (`rest/snippets.php` + `inf_snippets` CPT)
Meta: `code, description, hook, is_filter, priority, accepted_args, enabled, created_at`.
- `hook='manual'` → API-only. Any other string → registered dynamically on `init` prio 5
  via add_action/add_filter (user picks ANY WP/plugin hook).
- `is_filter=true` → must return (snippet return ∥ `$args[0]` passthrough).
- `is_filter=false` → echoed output printed (wp_head/wp_footer).
- Executor `inf_run_snippet_code()`: eval in ob + try/catch Throwable; scope vars:
  `$context, $snippet, $args(hook args), $params(request), $post_id, $post`.
- Errors: manual → JSON payload; auto → error_log under WP_DEBUG, page survives.
- Limitation: hooks before `init:5` unreachable.

---

## 18. DATA SHAPES
### inf_meta
`{saved:{html[],css,js,motions,bodyAttributes{},helmet{}}, before_save:{same}}`;
state picker = `save_state`; `before_save` ⇒ `need_publish_to_wp=true`.
### inf_config (option) — full key list
id, name, app_type, logo, colors, projectSetting, fonts, cssLibs, jsHeaderLibs, jsFooterLibs,
mainEditorScripts{header,footer}, mainEditorStyles, globalCss, globalJs, globalRules,
motions, interactions, conditions, queries, symbols, symbolBlocks, blocks, dynamicTemplates,
themes{config,path,root}, currentEditingPage, current_inf_meta, save_state, installStates,
scripts_need_arranged, scripts_need_to_publish, minified_css, minified_js, restAPIModels,
lastScreenshot, dbx_pull_requried, dropboxFileMeta, wp_media_config,
wp_meta{website_url,username,password,app_password}.
### Component node
`{tagName, attributes{}, classes[], content, components[]}` ∥ leaf `{type:'textnode',content}`.

---

## 19. EXTENSION POINTS
| Hook | Kind | Signature |
|---|---|---|
| `inf/normalize_post` | filter | `$result,$post_id,$post` |
| `inf/context` | filter | `$context,$filter_meta` |
| `inf/tokens/schema` | filter | `$groups,$context` |
| `inf_render_component` | filter | `false,$component,$save_state,$inf_config,$all` |
| `inf_before_render_components` | filter-as-action | `null,$components` |
| `inf_query_permission` / `inf_option_permission` | fn gates | — |

---

## 20. MEDIA / UPLOAD BUG GRAVEYARD (do not regress)
1. `wp_check_filetype_and_ext` must use ONE whitelist; `'*/*'` mime ⇒ file-icons + empty WC galleries.
2. Programmatic uploads MUST call `wp_generate_attachment_metadata` + `wp_update_attachment_metadata`
   (missing `sizes` ⇒ icons + unrenderable galleries; IDs still saved in `_product_image_gallery`).
3. REST never returns raw binary → base64 JSON (`/asset`).
4. Slug lookups need variants `name-jpg`/`name.jpg`/base (post_name, `_wp_attached_file`, guid, title).
5. UUID filenames = plugin uploader; WP admin keeps original names.
6. Repair pattern: fix mime (wp_check_filetype/finfo) + regenerate metadata, one-time admin trigger.

---

## 21. FRONTEND CONTRACT
- Auth: Basic app-password + `credentials:'include'`; **no X-WP-Nonce anywhere**.
- Workers: fetcher/pageBuilder/infinitely/assets via `wpWorkerCallbackMaker(w,cmd,props,cb)`.
- Storage: IndexedDB `db.projects` (+currentEditingPage/current_inf_meta), OPFS page files.
- Save: editor → `wp_update_meta(before_save, merge:true)` → BroadcastChannel `wp_preview_bc`
  → preview reload `?save_state=before_save`.
- Token picker: opens on `{{` in inputs under `inf-tokens-container` (ignores
  `inf-tokens-ignore`, monaco); Fuse-indexed, deferred filter, Virtuoso list.
- SCRIPT_DEFINITIONS (classic): infinitely.js, dev.js, swiper(+element), spline(module),
  gsap/scrollTrigger/splitText, auto-animate(IIFE global), petite-vue-animated, pVuePlugins,
  p-vue, initPVue. DEV: willChange, optimizeOutlines, gsapRuner.dev, pvMount.

---

## 22. GOTCHAS (numbered, read before touching)
1. Modules run last; global libs stay classic/IIFE.
2. `(int)$x ?? d` ⇒ 0 bug (empty schema).
3. REST+binary = corruption.
4. `max_leaves` budget cuts tail keys first (WC-enriched fields sit at object end).
5. Two-pass vars mandatory for `source`.
6. Metadata-less attachments look fine raw, break UI/galleries.
7. `get_page_by_path` exact-match only.
8. `inf_meta` single object → always merge-update.
9. `template_include` 5500 is late on purpose.
10. Snippet eval = admin-level power (login+origin gate only).
11. `body_class`/body-attr injection reads `saved` state only on front-end.
12. `inf_query_permission` blocks same-origin guest calls (no Origin / origin not listed) —
    cart on public storefront needs a public gate if guests must shop.

---

## 23. CHANGE MAP ("I want X → touch Y")
- New token group → `inf/context` filter (schema auto-follows).
- Enrich a post type → `inf/normalize_post` (WC/ACF pattern).
- New component tag/attr → `inf_render_component` filter (components/index.php pattern).
- New REST route → `rest/` + `inf_query_permission`.
- User PHP on any hook → snippets (`hook` field).
- New add-on → `ADD_ONES` + checker fn + loader already generic.
- Picker synonyms/docs-only tokens → `inf/tokens/schema`.
````
